title: grain/include@v1: the only object that adds names to a namespace. It names a file or a folder, and everything that file or folder contributes joins the namespace of the folder holding this object, unchanged (docs/task-repos.md §3.3)

target.description: A file, or a folder ending in /, by relative or /-rooted path, alias or git URL, with @<branch|tag|sha>. A relative or /-rooted target has no @: it reads the same commit as this object. A target in another repo must carry its @ref

ref_mode.description: track: @ names a branch, read at its tip on every fetch (live, as Silo's placements). pin: @ names a tag or a commit, and the target never changes under the includer (stable, as a shared template set). Required for a target in another repo

kinds.description: The object kinds this include accepts: a trust boundary on top of the Grain's local policy. Intersected with every include above it on the path. ["*"] accepts every kind. Include and exclude objects are configuration, and are always followed, but only within these kinds. Including capability objects makes them available to request, and never grants them (§5.7)

max_depth.description: Optional: how many further levels of includes below this one are followed. It can only lower the depth left on the path, never raise it
